name: Morning Manna

verse.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

lines: Gospel artist Mabel Okyere hosted believers in Suame-Kumasi for an uplifting evening of fellowship and worship at the Anuonyam Concert.
Royalhouse Chapel International has kicked off Day 1 of its annual Convention of Saints, gathering members for spiritual growth.
At a global Accra congress, President Mahama encouraged churches to support vulnerable people, mentor youth, and offer safe spaces.
Hearts of Oak aim to build momentum against struggling Vision FC following their recent narrow victory over Port City.
Brazil's Senate has approved a shorter workweek as the nation prepares for a closely contested presidential runoff election.
prayers: Lord, protect and provide for vulnerable families, youth, and those in need of practical relief and comfort today.
Grant wisdom and integrity to leaders worldwide as they make decisions that impact workers and local communities.
May God grant health, unity, and strength to worshipping congregations, athletes, and families across our nation.
